statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (S : Finset (ZMod N)), let u := fun x : ZMod N => if x ∈ S then (1:ℂ) else 0; (∑ k : ZMod N, ‖ZMod.dft u k‖^2)/(N:ℝ)^2 = (S.card:ℝ)/N

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 指定 Kummer 像与 Θ 测试 · JA-0045 · 从给定局部 Θ 测试精确恢复可测余类的占比
plain_statement.en: New route · Marked Kummer images and theta tests · JA-0045 · Recover the density of a specified union of residue classes from its Fourier test

brief.zh: 对指定像的指示函数使用同一计数 Haar 测度，平方和给出占比；向实际 ATS 运输时需固定这个 S。
brief.en: Use counting Haar measure on the prescribed image. Parseval yields its density, which must be transported for this S in the ATS model.
